source.title: Crystal structure of the wild-type heterocomplex between coil 1B domains of human intermediate filament proteins keratin 1 (KRT1) and keratin 10 (KRT10)
source.citation: Eldirany SA, Ho M, Hinbest AJ, Lomakin IB, Bunick CG. Human keratin 1/10-1B tetramer structures reveal a knob-pocket mechanism in intermediate filament assembly. EMBO J 2019;38(11):e100741. doi:10.15252/embj.2018100741

source.note: A short part of keratins of humans, and not of the mouse, made in bacteria. The biological assembly of the entry has two copies of each chain, the tetramer that the authors report.
